brief: 5 unhinged TikTok hooks that 10x'd our growth.

slots.title: Playbook Is Dead
slots.body: We stopped doing 'professional' TikToks and embraced pure chaos. These five unhinged hooks changed everything for our account in one week.

slots.title: Pretend It's Banned
slots.body: We filmed ourselves 'hiding' our product from the camera and whispering like it was contraband. People lost it. The comment section turned into a riot.

slots.title: Start With Oops
slots.body: Opening with 'I accidentally leaked our pricing' stopped thumbs instantly. Everyone waited for the tea. Instead they got our value prop and a sale.

slots.title: POV You're Shook
slots.body: POV: you just found out your competitor is using our tool and you're panicking. We filmed it as a meme. It hit a million views in three days.

slots.title: Hot Take Only
slots.body: We posted a video saying 'This feature should be illegal.' No context, just a deadpan stare. The rage bait worked and our DMs exploded with leads.

slots.title: Reverse The Ask
slots.body: We told people to NOT check our link in bio. Classic reverse psychology. Clicks went up 900% because humans love doing what they're told not to.

slots.headline: Steal These Hooks
slots.body: Save this post and test one hook today. Your next viral video starts with chaos.
